question_text: Which areas of the venue had the most crowd activity? Rank them by their average crowd size.
answer_text:
1) The busiest areas were DemoBooth_Intel (CAM_04), DemoBooth_NVIDIA (CAM_05), ExpoFloor_MainAisle (CAM_06), FoodCourt_North (CAM_07), and KeynoteHall_Stage (CAM_08) — the community covering those cameras had an average head_count (mean of means) ≈ 31.1974 (events from 2025-12-08T00:02:26Z to 2025-12-08T23:59:14Z; dataset hour range 2025-12-08T00:00:00Z–2025-12-08T23:00:00Z) (community_9).  
2) Next was Platform_1 with lower hour-by-hour averages: 5.05 (2025-12-01T11:01:47Z–11:59:48Z, community_6), 5.05 (2025-12-01T20:00:47Z–20:58:33Z, community_17), 5.03 (2025-12-01T16:01:45Z–16:59:32Z, community_11), 4.96 (2025-12-01T12:00:23Z–12:59:53Z, community_7), and 4.95 (2025-12-01T21:00:18Z–21:59:11Z, community_18).
